name: Sanmitra Commercial Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1985, Sanmitra Commercial 
 Ltd provides Commercial Services and does trading & marketing of various goods[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SCL provides securities trading services. It invests in shares, securities, and bonds and provides consultancy services. The company is also a dealer, importer, exporter, and commission agent of various goods.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.98 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of -5.98% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
